name: morphing_game_scene
summary: Godot 4.6.3 Node3D shell that fetches a ScenePlan from the dApp `/dapp/api/morph_plan` endpoint and morphs the active inner scene based on the caller's inferred persona/role. The shell stays mounted; only the PrimarySceneSlot child is swapped out at runtime, while a thin HUD reflects persona, role, primary_face id, and an accent color drawn from `plan.custom_css_vars['--accent']`. v1 falls back to a `play_default` (main.tscn) plan when no bearer token is present, so the scene also boots offline. Pairs with the dapp_server `/dapp/api/morph_plan` route (provided by sidecar agent J or runtime agent G) and the freetier_gate token storage.
engine_pattern: Two-node shell: ScenePlanLoader autoload owns the HTTP fetch + token read + plan_received signal; MorphingGameController is a per-scene Node3D that subscribes to that signal and (a) restyles the HUD, (b) load()s the PackedScene mapped by FACE_TO_SCENE for plan.primary_face, (c) clears previous children of PrimarySceneSlot and instantiates the new one. Resource resolution is defensive — missing scenes push_warning and bail. No per-frame work; everything happens in response to one plan_received signal.

scene_tree.MorphingGame/SubViewportContainer: CanvasLayer — host for the inner SubViewport
scene_tree.MorphingGame/SubViewportContainer/SubVie: SubViewport — isolated render target for the swapped scene
Node3D — empty slot; controller queue_frees its children then add_child(packed.instantiate())
scene_tree.MorphingGame/HUD/AccentRect: ColorRect — accent bar; color driven by plan.custom_css_vars['--accent']

face_to_scene_map.rationale: Five face_ids cover the seed persona archetypes. Realtor face maps to the property walkthrough; buyer face surfaces the rigged avatar (try-on flow); gamer face shows the social-graph planet; developer + default share main.tscn until a dedicated dev face exists.

scene_plan_schema_v1.auth: Authorization: Bearer <freetier_token>  (falls back to play_default when missing)
scene_plan_schema_v1.response_schema: { persona_id: String, inferred_role: String, primary_face: String, custom_css_vars: { '--accent': '#RRGGBB', ... } }
scene_plan_schema_v1.status: NOT YET IMPLEMENTED — sidecar agent J or runtime agent G owns the `/dapp/api/morph_plan` route. Until then, controller falls back to play_default and HUD shows persona=local_anon.
scene_plan_schema_v1.owner_to_add_route: dapp_server (route handler shipped by agent G / sidecar J)

token_sources.native_export: user://freetier_token.txt — written by the freetier flow when the bearer is bound to a host

runtime_requirements.autoload_required: true — ScenePlanLoader registered in project.godot [autoload] as '*res://src/scene_plan_loader.gd'
runtime_requirements.http_dependency: localhost:8520 must serve /dapp/api/morph_plan; offline boot uses the play_default fallback so the scene still renders

guarantees: Boots without backend — missing/empty token short-circuits to play_default and the HUD reports persona=local_anon
Surgical project.godot edit — exactly ONE new line in [autoload]; no other autoload, scene, or script is touched
Scene swap is idempotent — _swap_primary_scene queue_frees existing PrimarySceneSlot children before instantiating
Missing PackedScene paths fail soft via push_warning, not crash
FACE_TO_SCENE is a const dictionary — adding a new face is a one-line append, no controller refactor
blockers_phase_2: dapp_server: add GET /dapp/api/morph_plan route that returns { persona_id, inferred_role, primary_face, custom_css_vars } (owned by sidecar agent J or runtime agent G)
freetier_gate: confirm token write to user://freetier_token.txt on native exports and to localStorage 'mspc_freetier_token' on web export
New face_ids: add the corresponding scene path to FACE_TO_SCENE — e.g. play_artist -> wardrobe scene, play_trader -> trade dashboard
SubViewportContainer sizing — wire SubViewport.size to the viewport size if the shell is used at non-1920x1080 aspect ratios
Plan refresh: currently fetched once on _ready; add a 'morph' signal so plan changes during a session can hot-swap the inner scene
usage_example:
# From main_controller or any scene:
get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://scenes/morphing_game.tscn")
# Or load + instantiate inline:
var packed = load("res://scenes/morphing_game.tscn")
add_child(packed.instantiate())
phase: B.2 — first persona-driven scene shell. Pairs with dapp_server (`/dapp/api/morph_plan` provider), freetier_gate (token issuer), and the five seed face scenes (realestate_walkthrough_full, avatar_rigged, planet_map, main).
